title: Stygian End Rebirth
description: Pushing Stygian End out of darkness and into the modern era!
body:
**Welcome to Stygian End Rebirth!**


Stygian End Rebirth is a port of the Stygian End mod (Specifically Stygian End Re-Continuation)



The mod contains:



3 woodsets for decorative purpopses

Tons of new mobs to face and encounter. some weird and some deadly!

5 new beautiful, well designed biomes that fit into the alien landscape of the end. 



Will you be able to survive the new Stygian End? or will you fade into darkness?
